steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with Vendor A's bid; no creation or event-list steps are needed.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the test configuration.
Apply the required post-expiry surrogate-bidding configuration.
Enable buyer editing of bidding fields as required.
Apply the required evaluation-reopen permission configuration.
Open the RFQ stage menu and launch the Recreate Order window.
Enter the requested zero event-end duration in the available duration control.
Enter the requested negative evaluation duration.
Set the future delivery date specified by the case.
Submit the Recreate Order form to observe how the numeric values are handled.
Assert that the negative evaluation duration is rejected at the relevant field.
